# kubernetes_jwks

This data source reads the OpenID Connect JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) published by the Kubernetes API server and exposes both the raw payload and a parsed key list.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (List of Map of String) List of JWKS keys as key/value string maps.
- `raw` (String) Raw JSON payload returned from `/openid/v1/jwks`.
